messages:
anya (PM): NimbusHealth asked for a focused 'Optimize Advisor' pilot: per-route batching/caching presets, ranked quantization advice, and eval-triggered alerts. Concierge onboarding, then self-serve opt-in. They want results in ~6 weeks. Can we compress scope?
diego (Eng): We can do a trimmed MVP: 1) a snapshot analyzer to output batch_size + cache_on boolean, 2) a static quant recommendation doc (no automated apply), 3) scheduled evals + Console/email alerts. Limit models to verified open LMs to reduce testing surface.
ravi (ML): For alerts we need customer-supplied eval vectors. Recommend 250-500 pairs. Seeded regression harness will simulate temp spikes, prompt truncation, and template corruption to measure precision. Suggest default alert rule: metric_drop_pct >= 3% sustained over 2 runs.
hana (Solutions): NimbusHealth can provide obfuscated prompts. They want conservative alerts and a human review step before any immediate high-severity emails during concierge. They also asked for a simple ROI estimate card.
sophie (CS): Add p99 latency delta guidance in the quant doc. Customers care about latency regressions after quantization. Also provide a telemetry opt-out toggle.
diego (Eng): Implementation plan: - Analyzer (offline) consumes a short traffic dump + perf traces -> recommends batch/cache and candidate quant profiles. - Eval runner = k8s CronJob that runs provided vectors on pinned model -> emits metrics to telemetry. - Alert router maps eval signals to Console/email.
anya (PM): Launch criteria draft: MUST: analyzer recommendations surfaced in Console, quant shortlist doc with tradeoffs, eval-alerts wired to Console/email, concierge onboarding playbook. SHOULD: ROI estimate, seeded-regression verification.
ravi (ML): Success criteria for pilot acceptance: - Customer applies at least one recommendation OR estimated token savings >=8% on sample workload - Alert precision >= 65% on seeded events - Concierge onboarding completed within 3 weeks
diego (Eng): Rough schedule: 2w core build (analyzer + eval runner) + 1w Console integration + 1w polish + 1w pilot = 5w if we prioritize. Team: 1 BE eng, 0.5 infra, 0.5 ML eng, 0.5 PM. Dependencies: Console alerts API, job runner quota, model perf profiler.
hana (Solutions): Runbook items: data intake checklist, obfuscation guide, human review flow, thresholds agreement form, ROI template. NimbusHealth prefers hosted MVP; they accepted that.
anya (PM): Risks: noisy alerts, quant suggestions hurting long-context routes, insufficient traffic for reliable recommendations, privacy concerns. Mitigations: conservative defaults, human-in-the-loop triage, explicit long-context caveat, require opt-in telemetry.
ops-bot: deploy scheduled: optimize-advisor/mini-nimbus -> staging at 2024-11-20T14:00:00Z
sophie (CS): Recommend alert throttling and weekly digest by default with immediate critical alerts gated by human review.
anya (PM): Owners: diego -> eng impl, ravi -> seeded-reg harness, hana -> customer onboarding, sophie -> runbook + CS signals, anya -> success metrics + pilot SLA. Next: diego & ravi to produce a 1-pager tech spec by EOD Thu. Emoji react if you accept scope. :thumbsup: = yes, :thumbsdown: = objection.
